resources.string: Selectable scale · Preprocess pages · Save results · Works with translation

waifu2x enlarges still images at the selected scale; 4× and 8× use repeated 2× enhancement. Speed mode is the default; quality mode preserves grayscale more closely. Tap the reader SR button to enable, or hold it to process the whole gallery, retry a page, or compare images. When both features need a page, translation finishes first, then super-resolution, before the next page starts. Each feature keeps its own preprocessing range and reads the original. Results are saved in tiles; interrupted work resumes from saved tiles. Animations and images that cannot fit the working memory budget are skipped.

Automatic chooses the smallest of 2×, 4× and 8× that makes the short side at least 1200px, capped at 8×. Very small images may remain below 1200px. Higher scales take more time and storage. Changes apply when you return to the reader.

Keep reusable tiles in app private storage. When the gallery has a local folder, also save complete lossless PNGs in its _suepr_resolution subfolder. Previously saved tiles are exported when processed again, without running the model. Original files are preserved.
Delete app-private SR results for all galleries? Exported PNGs in _suepr_resolution, originals and translation results are preserved.
